name: gen-docs
description: VitePress default theme ported to Zola (Tailwind CSS)

scripts.test: cargo test --quiet && npm run build:js && npm run build:css && npm run check:demo && npm run check:parity
scripts.parity:refresh: cp parity/upstream.json parity/upstream.prev.json 2>/dev/null; node scripts/parity-refresh.mjs && cargo run --quiet -- parity snapshot parity/cache --meta parity/cache/meta.json && cargo run --quiet -- parity diff parity/upstream.prev.json parity/upstream.json; rm -f parity/upstream.prev.json
scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css && cargo run --quiet -- build demo
scripts.dev: npm run watch:css & npm run watch:js & cargo run -- serve demo & wait
